articles.summary: Newport Beach, CA | July 1, 2026 American Vanguard Corporation (NYSE: AVD) today announced that Hermann Castro has joined its executive team as Senior Vice President, Marketing and Business Development. Mr. Castro brings more than 25 years of global leadership experience across the agricultural value chain, including crop protection, seed and traits, production agriculture, and fresh produce systems.
